summary.text: Adrian Fontes is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, a Marine Corps veteran, former prosecutor and former Maricopa County Recorder, elected in 2022. His campaign focuses on protecting early voting and vote-by-mail, voter privacy and election funding.

paragraphs.text: Marine Corps veteran who served on active duty from 1992 to 1996; later a prosecutor in Denver and Maricopa County and head of the International Prosecution Unit at the Arizona Attorney General's Office.
Maricopa County Recorder before his 2022 election as Secretary of State.
